_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,857 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 202 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2015 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and multi-channel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability or price using digital tools.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'In 2015, sales through our online selling channels accounted for approximately 3% of our total sales.'. The stock trades at 19.1x FY16E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,857 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 202 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.17x; +47% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.43; conservative 2yr +28%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +20.3%/yr (FY16 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.3%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2016-04-01) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.17x (52.9% downside to Bear $36 / +45.1% upside to Bull $111) | Adj composite 1.98 vs market 2.41: gap -0.43 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +47% above the EPP floor $52 (13x FY16E $4.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +27.5% total (+13.7%/yr) | At 19.1x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $101 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps +5.2% in Q4 FY15, forward sales +6% (FY16 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
